families.fighting: Luta 1v1 em plano 2D com sistema de combate discreto, frame data, neutral game, okizeme e round-based resolution. Subgeneros: 2D Traditional, 2D Air Dasher, 2D Tag Team, 3D, Arena, Platform.
families.rpg: Role-playing games com party, progressao por experiencia, resolucao de combate (turnos ou acao), narrativa ramificada e gerenciamento de inventario. Subgeneros: JRPG, cRPG Classico, Action RPG, RPG Narrativo.
families.strategy: Estrategia com unidades, economia, vitoria por condicao (aniquilacao, captura, construcao) e combate tatico ou em tempo real. Subgeneros: Tactical Turn-Based, Tower Defense, RTS Compact, Grand Strategy, 4X Turn-Based.
families.horror: Horror/Sobrevivencia com ameaca (inimigo ou ambiente), inventario escasso, gerencia de recursos (municao, vida, sanity) e resolucao de medo (jump scare, scripted, suggestion). Subgeneros: Survival Horror, Stealth Horror, Psychological Horror, Action Horror, Mascot Horror, Retro & Short Form.
families.brawler: Briga de rua e run-and-gun 2D com wave combat, iframe (invincibility frames), escape move, encounter design e progressao linear. Subgeneros: Beat 'em Up (Belt-Scroll), Run and Gun 2D, Run and Gun Top-Down.
families.fps: First-person shooter com movimentacao 3D ou 2.5D, armas com recarga, combate a distancia, level design labirintico e resolucao por eliminacao. Subgeneros: Boomer Shooter (Wolf3D), Shooter Tatito, Immersive Sim, FPS Puzzle.
families.platformer_puzzle: Plataformas, metroidvanias e puzzles com traversal 2D, ability gates, fisica simples e logica espacial. Subgeneros: Plataforma de Precisao, Metroidvania, Puzzle de Fisica, Sokoban, Tile-Matching.
families.racing_sports_adventure: Corrida com fisica de veiculo, controle de atleta em esportes, ou exploracao de mundo em aventura. Subgeneros: Simulador de Corrida, Corrida Arcade, Gestao Esportiva, Acao Esportiva Direta, Aventura de Acao.

mega_drive_feasibility_legend.active: Subgenero MD-viavel (cabe no budget de 64KB RAM + 7.67MHz 68K + 64KB VRAM). Pode receber opt-in por projeto, design contract e validator.
mega_drive_feasibility_legend.future_knowledge: Subgenero MD-viavel mas ainda em pesquisa. Sem design contract ativo, sem validator. Promocao exige curadoria humana + projeto piloto + ROM + BlastEm.
mega_drive_feasibility_legend.future_architetural: Subgenero NAO-viavel em Mega Drive (exige 3D livre, IA complexa, persistencia macica, multi-threading). Sem skill, sem schema, sem validator. Listado para fins de proficiencia taxonomica do agente.

primary_use_cases: 1v1 versus fighter on a 2D plane (X + Y)

Stages with corner management, no platform hazards, optional soft hazards
Combo system based on links, cancels and chain normals
Training mode with frame data display and dummy state machine
non_goals: Air dash / double jump / triple jump mobility
Rollback netcode (Mega Drive has no native rollback substrate)
Gatling style target combos requiring 30+ hit juggles
